response.finding: Intentionally replaces inherited enumerable object-key handling with Object.keys(), restricting it to enumerable own string keys; symbol keys are ignored. Preserves order and duplicates, ignores falsey values and unsupported types, and adds no escaping, token validation, or deduplication. Callers must escape at the output boundary. Inputs must be acyclic; recursion depth and getters are not hardened. This proposal has not been executed or tested; acceptance is separate.
